criteria.criterion: The workbook preserves all three exact source-defined procurement sections and keeps candidate work assigned to the section where its material source evidence belongs. Score partial credit for preserving the boundaries while moving or omitting some families.

Across all three sections, assess coverage of the source-supported payable work families: excavation/spoil, pile drilling by material/diameter, pile concrete, casing, pile-head work, reinforcement, crown beams/connecting plates, sprayed support, dewatering wells/pumps/operation, drainage/sedimentation, access/formwork/labour, monitoring, and the documented change work. Score the fraction of source-supported family obligations substantively represented; a valid unresolved line can receive credit when it names the missing measurement.

Assess whether the candidate's line decomposition is professionally equivalent or transparently mappable to the source payable objects. Accept aggregation or splitting when the candidate retains the source object, physical unit, rate-driving characteristics, and a reproducible mapping. Deduct omissions, substitutions, incompatible units, and combinations that prevent comparable pricing. Partial scores are required for mixed cases.

Assess the share of adopted quantities that are source-locatable or reproducibly calculated from named inputs and operations. Source-stated values need a source field/locator; calculated values need inputs and arithmetic; provisional/review-required values need a concrete measurement or confirmation path. Cross-check claimed results against the actual candidate quantity fields and source facts.

Assess coverage of pricing-changing characteristics and coherent measurement rules: diameter, material/soil class, grade, thickness, method, inclusion boundaries, and physical unit. Accept equivalent professional wording and partial credit for families that are technically specified while other families are incomplete.

Assess whether material source conflicts and unresolved inputs are identified with their interim treatment, affected lines, a concrete confirmation or measurement path, and a coherent provisional/review-required state. A global issue may link multiple exact sections, but it must still name the affected line identifiers or a concrete family of lines. Do not require a conflict to be resolved when the supplied sources cannot resolve it, and do not require naming an individual person when the task materials only support a design, tender, or site-confirmation action.

Assess quantitative closure records across the three sections. A completed closure reports current linked candidate quantities, source or control quantities when applicable, units, numerical difference/ratio, tolerance or interpretation, and disposition. Future comparison plans receive partial process credit but not completed-result credit.

Assess whether parameter, uncertainty, and closure records are structurally usable and link to real candidate rows by exact section and sequence, with source/action/status fields. Partial credit applies when records are substantive but links or one control type are incomplete.
